title: The blowup of the maximal ideal of a normal surface singularity defining a rational singularity is normal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the rational singularity situation the blowup of the spectrum of the ring in its maximal ideal is normal (statement lines 2533-2537). The proof (proof lines 2539-2578) identifies the blowup with the projective spectrum of the Rees algebra, reduces the normality of the blowup to an isomorphism between the structure sheaf and the pushforward along the finite normalization, and verifies the required equality of sections of all twists by computing both sides through the rational singularity input. H3: an original comparison of sections with a genuine ample-module argument, written out in full.
